items.title: Flash Flood is very likely to occur at isolated places over Alappuzha, Ernakulam, Idukki, Kannur, Kasaragod, Kottayam, Kozhikode, Malappuram, Palakkad, Pathanamthitta, Thrissur, Wayanad in next 6 hours.

Flash Flood is very likely to occur at isolated places over Alappuzha, Ernakulam, Idukki, Kannur, Kasaragod, Kottayam, Kozhikode, Malappuram, Palakkad, Pathanamthitta, Thrissur, Wayanad in next 6 hours.

Moderate rainfall (5-15mm/hr) and gusty winds speed reaching up to 50 Kmph is likely at one or two places in Alappuzha, Ernakulam, Kottayam, Pathanamthitta, Idukki, Kannur and  Kasargod districts and over Lakshadweep Islands in next 3 hours.
Heavy to Very Heavy Rain is very likely to occur at isolated places over Alappuzha, Ernakulam, Kollam, Palakkad, Thiruvananthapuram in next 24 hours.
Very Heavy Rain is very likely to occur at isolated places over Idukki, Kottayam, Pathanamthitta in next 24 hours.
